profile_text.body:
DXC Technology Co is a public company headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, with the ticker DXC and SEC CIK 0001688568. The website associated with it is dexus.com.

The text harvested from that site describes a different business. It presents Dexus as an Australasian real estate and infrastructure fund manager with four decades of experience in real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development. The site cites Atlassian Central in Sydney, described as the world's tallest hybrid timber tower at more than 180 metres, and a Brisbane office converted into 1,180 student beds. It identifies itself as Dexus (ASX: DXS) and states that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance. None of this describes DXC Technology Co.

No AI products or MCP servers are listed for the company, and no lawsuits are recorded against it. Its law exposure is in Virginia, with a count of 152.
